title: Payment-Record Bonus on Deductible Rewards Claim-Free Credit, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Term.** The Deductible Rewards claim-free credit of a vehicle insured under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage carries a payment-record bonus read from the policy's Cardinal Billing Account. Where the policy's billing account is enrolled in autopay and shows no returned payment posted within the last 12 months, 25 is added; where the billing account is not enrolled in autopay and shows no such returned payment, 10 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The bonus is added to the annual credit, and it is that sum which is reduced to the room left under the credit cap.

The autopay setting is read from the Cardinal Billing Account; returned payments are the returned-payment entries posted on its ledger within the last 12 months.

## Basis questions and answers (hypothetical accounts)

**The billing account is on autopay and its ledger shows no returned payment in the last 12 months.** 25 is added.

**The account is not enrolled in autopay and shows no returned payment in that period.** 10 is added.

**The account is on autopay but a payment was returned 8 months ago.** A returned payment within the last 12 months: nothing is added.

**A payment was returned 14 months ago and none since, account on autopay.** The returned payment is outside the 12-month window: 25 is added.

**The policy has no billing account on record.** Nothing is added.

| Autopay on the Cardinal Billing Account | Returned payment posted within the last 12 months | Bonus (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None | 25 |
| No | None | 10 |
| Either | One or more | 0 |
| No billing account | — | 0 |
